title: Nav2 Documentation
summary: Official Nav2 documentation: concepts, configuration guides for every planner/controller/costmap plugin, tuning guide and tutorials including GPS-based navigation.
key_takeaways: Tuning guide explains planner/controller trade-offs
Tutorials cover writing custom plugins and outdoor GPS waypoints

title: Nav2 ROSCon Talks (index)
summary: Curated index of ROSCon talks by the Nav2 team and community from 2018 onward, covering features such as Smac planners and the MPPI controller plus tuning and deployment advice.
key_takeaways: Single entry point for Nav2 conference talks
Talks on MPPI and Smac planners explain design rationale

title: The Marathon 2: A Navigation System
summary: Paper introducing Nav2: behavior-tree based navigation architecture for ROS 2, its design choices and a long-duration campus deployment test.
key_takeaways: Explains why Nav2 uses behavior trees and lifecycle nodes
Describes long-running real-world validation

title: From the Desks of ROS Maintainers: A Survey of Modern & Capable Mobile Robotics Algorithms in the Robot Operating System 2
summary: Survey by ROS maintainers of the mobile robotics algorithms available in ROS 2: localization, SLAM, planning, control and perception packages, with their maturity and use.
key_takeaways: Map of which ROS 2 packages are production-ready
Good orientation before choosing a localization or planning stack

title: The Open Motion Planning Library (OMPL) website
summary: Official OMPL documentation with planner catalogue, tutorials, Python binding guide and benchmarking tools.
key_takeaways: Tutorials show how to define state spaces and validity checkers
Built-in benchmarking compares planners on your problem

title: EGO-Planner: An ESDF-free Gradient-based Local Planner for Quadrotors
summary: Introduces a local planner that avoids building a full Euclidean signed distance field, computing collision penalties only from obstacles the trajectory intersects, cutting onboard compute.
key_takeaways: ESDF-free collision cost reduces mapping overhead
Fits small onboard computers for agile flight

title: Robust and Efficient Quadrotor Trajectory Generation for Fast Autonomous Flight
summary: Fast-Planner paper: kinodynamic path search front-end plus B-spline optimization and time adjustment for fast quadrotor flight in unknown environments.
key_takeaways: Front-end/back-end split is the template many later planners follow

title: Aerostack2: A Software Framework for Developing Multi-robot Aerial Systems
summary: Describes the Aerostack2 ROS 2 architecture for aerial robotics: platform abstraction, behaviors, mission specification and multi-robot support.
key_takeaways: Platform abstraction lets the same mission run on several autopilots and simulators

title: PlanSys2: A Planning System Framework for ROS2
summary: Presents PlanSys2, a PDDL planning and execution framework for ROS 2 that compiles plans into behavior trees and supports multi-robot execution.
key_takeaways: Shows how symbolic task planning connects to Nav2 actions

title: Fields2Cover: An open-source coverage path planning library for unmanned agricultural vehicles
summary: Paper behind the Fields2Cover library: modular coverage pipeline (headlands, swaths, route ordering, path smoothing) and benchmark of its components.
key_takeaways: Coverage planning decomposes cleanly into swath generation, ordering and turning

title: Cursor-on-Target Message Router User's Guide
summary: MITRE guide describing Cursor-on-Target: the base Event schema (what, where, when), its mandatory fields, sub-schema extensions and the message router used to distribute CoT.
key_takeaways: CoT base event is deliberately terse with a small set of mandatory fields
Type strings follow a hierarchical code derived from MIL-STD-2525

title: Developer's Guide to Cursor on Target
summary: Introductory developer guide to CoT's objectives, message structure, implementation patterns and limitations.
key_takeaways: Explains the what/where/when design philosophy
Good primer before writing a CoT producer

title: cot-types: Collection of Cursor-on-Target types
summary: Community-compiled list of CoT type strings with mappings to other message formats, useful when choosing the 'type' attribute for tracks.
key_takeaways: Pick correct atom/friend/hostile type codes for your tracks

title: MIL-STD-2525D Joint Military Symbology
summary: US DoD standard defining military symbology (frames, icons, modifiers and the symbol identification code) for C2 displays. Revision E (2022) is current and sold through standards resellers; 2525D was published openly on jcs.mil.
key_takeaways: SIDC structure drives symbol rendering in milsymbol
Know which revision your consumers expect (2525C vs D/E codes differ)

title: TAK.gov - Team Awareness Kit portal
summary: Official TAK portal for ATAK/WinTAK/iTAK/TAK Server downloads, plugin SDKs and documentation; most materials require free registration.
key_takeaways: Register early - SDK and server downloads are behind an account

title: OpenTAKServer Documentation
summary: Installation and configuration docs for OpenTAKServer, including client enrollment, certificates and integrations.
key_takeaways: Step-by-step install on Ubuntu or Raspberry Pi

title: PyTAK documentation
summary: Docs and examples for PyTAK: configuration, transports (TCP/UDP/TLS/multicast) and writing CoT producers.
key_takeaways: Example scripts are a minimal template for pushing positions to TAK

title: The 1090 Megahertz Riddle: A Guide to Decoding Mode S and ADS-B Signals
summary: Open book explaining Mode S and ADS-B message structure, position decoding (CPR), Comm-B registers and Mode S surveillance, with pyModeS examples.
key_takeaways: CPR position decoding explained step by step
Covers enhanced surveillance fields beyond basic ADS-B

title: EUROCONTROL ASTERIX
summary: EUROCONTROL home of the ASTERIX surveillance data exchange format, with category specifications for radar, ADS-B, MLAT and system tracks.
key_takeaways: Categories (e.g. 048 radar, 021 ADS-B, 062 system tracks) define the binary layouts

title: SpatioTemporal Asset Catalog (STAC) specification
summary: Specification and ecosystem site for STAC, the common way to describe and search geospatial imagery and DEM assets.
key_takeaways: Public STAC APIs give key-free access to Sentinel-2 and Copernicus DEM

title: Copernicus DEM on AWS Open Data
summary: Registry entry for the Copernicus global DEM (GLO-30/GLO-90) hosted as cloud-optimized GeoTIFFs on AWS, freely accessible without an account.
key_takeaways: Global 30 m DEM as COGs - sample directly with rasterio
Good default terrain for terrain-referenced nav and planning

title: GeographicLib documentation
summary: Documentation and background on geodesics, map projections, geoid and gravity models implemented in GeographicLib, plus online calculators.
key_takeaways: Geoid undulation matters when comparing GNSS ellipsoid heights to DEM heights
